title: Archive and Colony
author: Wren Villalobos
blurb: Yara Lockridge, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
